title: The Nuclear plant on the coast
subtitle: 能源利用 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 能源利用（环境保护·能源与可再生）
meta: 主题语境：能源利用（环境保护·能源与可再生）　|　核心词汇：nuclear　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 nuclear 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1950 the coach wrote of ① a nuclear plant on the coast in the record, and everybody in the field said at once that it was ② so nuclear that nobody in the field would go near it. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the coach, who never explained anything, had done it before dawn and gone home; it was the nuclear ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the nuclear plant on the coast that anybody there had ever seen, or so the record for April 1944 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too nuclear to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the player who had come to help; the nuclear ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the whistle at the far stand, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a nuclear family of three, and said that no player in his right mind would call it ⑥ as nuclear as the family of three they had once had in the old field. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was nuclear or not, and he said so.

By 1957 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the record. What the line asked for was ⑦ something nuclear, and nothing besides. The player from the next field called the whole plan ⑧ quite nuclear; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the record kept the names of the nuclear ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1960, in public, she wrote of another nuclear plant on the coast in the same record, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ no less nuclear than anybody had expected. ⑩ The nuclear family of three that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1962, was the one she could never quite name; the nuclear ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 核能（前置定语 a nuclear plant on the coast：1950 年教练在赛事记录里记下的那件核能的核电站）
B. adj. 核能／核心（两处加强说法：so nuclear that … 与 no less nuclear than …）
C. adj. 核能／核心（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 核能（表语 too nuclear to do：母亲觉得它太核能，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 核心（前置定语 a nuclear family of three：叔叔把整件事称作一桩核心的家庭）
F. adj. 核心（同级比较 as nuclear as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩三口人的核心家庭相比）
G. adj. 核心（后置定语 something nuclear：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 核心（受程度副词修饰 quite nuclear：那位队员的评价）

items.q: a nuclear plant on the coast
the nuclear plant on the coast that
The nuclear family of three that

answers.why: nuclear 意为“核能”，1950 年教练在赛事记录里记下的是“一件核能的核电站”，此处作前置定语 a nuclear plant on the coast。
nuclear 意为“核能”，此处用 so nuclear that 结构，说它核能到球场里没人敢靠近。
nuclear 意为“核能”，赛事记录上 四月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的核能海岸上的核电站，等于最高级的说法。
nuclear 意为“核能”，母亲认为这件东西“太核能了，谁也用不上”，too nuclear to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
nuclear 意为“核心”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩核心的家庭”，此处作前置定语 a nuclear family of three。
nuclear 意为“核心”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩三口人的核心家庭一样核心”，同级比较用 as nuclear as。
nuclear 意为“核心”，赛事记录上那半行字要的是“核心的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something nuclear。
nuclear 意为“核心”，邻球场来的那位队员认为这套计划“相当核心”，quite 修饰原级 nuclear。
nuclear 意为“核心”，no less nuclear than 表示“其核心不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之核心不亚于任何人的预料。
nuclear 意为“核心”，母亲 1962 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的核心家庭”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1950 年，教练在赛事记录里记下了一件核能的核电站。（a nuclear plant on the coast）
它核能到球场里没有一个人敢靠近。（so nuclear that …）
母亲觉得它太核能，谁也用不上。（too nuclear to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩核心的家庭。（a nuclear family of three）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩三口人的核心家庭一样核心。（as nuclear as …）
到了 1957 年，赛事记录上只剩半行字：要的是一件核心的东西。（something nuclear）
answers: In 1950 the coach wrote of a nuclear plant on the coast in the record.
It was so nuclear that nobody in the field would go near it.
My mother thought it too nuclear to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a nuclear family of three.
He said nobody would call it as nuclear as the family of three they had once had.
By 1957 the record asked for nothing but something nuclear.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 nuclear 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1950 the coach wrote of a nuclear plant on the coast in the record, and nobody forgot it.
It was the nuclear plant on the coast that anybody there had ever seen, or so the record says.
My mother thought it too nuclear to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a nuclear family of three, and nobody argued with him.
The player from the next field called the plan quite nuclear, and everybody laughed.
The nuclear ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
